verdict.rationale: Pylon's own published OpenAPI spec lists separate US and EU production API servers, which points to regional (US/EU) deployments of the product. Nothing documents data residency as a customer choice or says where data is actually stored. missing for 10: explicit data-residency documentation, how a customer selects a US or EU region, a statement of where data is stored at rest, any additional regions, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: the spec's only servers are the US/EU production APIs
